acceptance: Each listed binary matches its publisher's checksum or signature, or has been reinstalled from a verified download or removed
description: These tools on the maintainer's Mac were installed or updated with `curl ... | sh` through `/usr/bin/curl`, which trusted the compromised eMudhra emSign CAs until 2026-10-23, and carry only ad-hoc signatures, so nothing independent of TLS vouches for them: px0, clickhousectl, jcode, cedardb, prime-agent and `/tmp/chbin/clickhouse`. Compare each against its publisher's checksums or signatures fetched with a trusted client (uv 0.13.5, or Python with certifi >= 2026.10.18), and reinstall or remove any that do not match. `muse` updates itself hourly through `/usr/bin/curl` and checks a sha256 fetched over the same channel; the system bundle is fixed now, but consider asking for a signed update or pinning.
